'''Peter Todd''' is a Canadian software developer who was an early contributor to the development of [[Bitcoin]].<ref name="BBC">{{Cite web |title=Peter Todd: I am not Bitcoin inventor, says man named in HBO film |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c62m73my0dno |access-date=2024-10-15 |website=www.bbc.com |language=en-GB}}</ref> Todd has been involved in [[cryptocurrency]] since the early 2010s and has worked on blockchain and privacy-focused projects.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2024-10-09 |title=HBO Documentary Suggests Bitcoin Creator Satoshi Nakamoto Is Developer Peter Todd |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-10-09/hbo-documentary-suggests-bitcoin-creator-satoshi-nakamoto-is-peter-todd |access-date=2024-10-15 |work=Bloomberg.com |language=en}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Peter Todd was born in Canada. When he was 15 years old he began communicating with [[cypherpunks]] like [[Adam Back]] and [[Hal Finney (computer scientist)|Hal Finney]].<ref name="politico">{{Cite news |last = Kaminska | first=Izabella  | date=2024-10-09 |title=Bitcoin creator is Peter Todd, HBO film says |url=https://www.politico.eu/article/peter-todd-bitcoin-creator-cullen-hoback-hbo-cryptocurrency-satoshi-nakamoto/ |access-date=2024-10-15 |website=POLITICO |language=en-GB}}</ref> Before his career as a core developer, Peter Todd attended the [[Ontario College of Art and Design]] in Toronto.<ref name=politico/> 

In 2019, Todd filed a [[United States defamation law|defamation suit]] against former [[Tor (network)|Tor]] developer Isis Lovecruft after they publicly accused him of rape and sexual misconduct on [[Twitter]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Brandom |first=Russell |date=2019-10-02 |title=A disgraced Tor developer has resurfaced to testify against one of his accusers |url=https://www.theverge.com/2019/10/2/20895270/jacob-appelbaum-peter-todd-rape-allegations-defamation-bitcoin-tor |access-date=2025-02-25 |website=The Verge |language=en-US}}</ref>

==Cryptocurrency involvement==

In 2014 Todd stated that [[Gavin Andresen]] had been responsible for code changes that resulted in Bitcoin's rising fees.<ref name="MITGavin">{{Cite web |last=Simonite|first=Tom|date=15 August 2014 |title=The Man Who Really Built Bitcoin|url=https://www.technologyreview.com/2014/08/15/12784/the-man-who-really-built-bitcoin/ |access-date=2025-02-03 |website=MIT Tech Review|language=en}}</ref> In 2017 Todd was against an increase in the Bitcoin block size in relation to the controversy surrounding the [[Bitcoin scalability problem]] and [[SegWit]].<ref>{{Cite news |date=2017-03-13 |title=Majority of bitcoin miners signal rebellion amid sluggish ‘blockchain’ |url=https://www.gulf-times.com/story/537284/majority-of-bitcoin-miners-signal-rebellion-amid-sluggish-blockchain |access-date=2025-02-23 |work=Bloomberg |language=en}}</ref>

The 2024 [[HBO]] documentary ''[[Money Electric: The Bitcoin Mystery]]'' by [[Cullen Hoback]] named Todd as [[Bitcoin]]'s pseudonymous creator, [[Satoshi Nakamoto]]. Todd has publicly denied being Nakamoto, stating in the film that it was "ludicrous".<ref name="politico"/><ref name="BBC"/> Hoback's theory includes a range of circumstantial evidence.<ref name=":9">{{Cite web |last=Dugan |first=Kevin T. |date=2024-10-08 |title=A Quest to Unmask Bitcoin Inventor Satoshi Nakamoto Finds a Man Named Peter Todd |url=https://nymag.com/intelligencer/article/peter-todd-bitcoin-satoshi-nakamoto-hbo.html |access-date=2024-12-03 |website=Intelligencer |language=en}}</ref><ref name="Sarlin">{{Cite web |last=Sarlin |first=Jon |date=9 October 2024 |title='I am not Satoshi Nakamoto': Subject of HBO documentary denies he invented bitcoin |url=https://edition.cnn.com/2024/10/08/investing/satoshi-nakamoto-identity/index.html |access-date=2024-10-09 |website=CNN |language=en}}</ref> In the film, Todd denied that he was Nakamoto, saying that it was "ludicrous" and "grasping at straws". Todd criticized Hoback for "[[QAnon]] style coincidence-based conspiracy thinking".<ref>{{Cite web |last=Roberts |first=Jeff John |date=October 9, 2024 |title=HBO doc reveals Bitcoin creator is Peter Todd—that's wrong but 'Money Electric' is still a good watch |url=https://fortune.com/crypto/2024/10/08/who-invented-bitcoin-hbo-peter-todd/ |access-date=2024-10-09 |website=Fortune Crypto |language=en}}</ref><ref name="Sarlin"/> No concrete evidence has been presented to support the claim, and the theory remains entirely speculative.
